malariafwd v0.1.0 — implementation notes and traps

Source: IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md

Traps for anyone who changes the model script (inst/slim/malariafwd_vivax.slim) or reads its tree sequence. The model description says what the model does; design decisions says why.

Eidos scoping. A plain assignment to a global inside a callback or function creates a local. Use defineGlobal(). The trap is silent: a list filled this way inside a callback never reaches early(), which is why RECRUD_RETIRE, the genomes a recrudescence replaces, is kept with defineGlobal(). A hypnozoite batch is retired differently, by setting its own count to 0, which the validation suite’s over-draw check (validation) watches: a batch left unretired would keep activating after it had run out.

Vacant tskit nodes. SLiM haploid individuals get two nodes — the real haplosome (is_vacant = [0]) and an isolated null placeholder (is_vacant = [1], IBD 0 with everything). ~50% of ts.samples() are vacant and must be filtered. Any new tskit code must do this.

The genealogy is a forest. Founders have independent roots; ~93% of pairs never coalesce. tskit branch-mode divergence() is therefore not a relatedness measure here, and a time to the most recent common ancestor (TMRCA) derived from it can come out older than the run itself. Use ibd_pairs() / arg_tmrca().

Integer and float spellings. -d X=0 makes an Eidos integer and -d X=0.0 a float, and Eidos will not mix the two in some places (rbinom(), seqLen(), subsetting, a tick range). The model converts a parameter to the type it needs where it uses it there (asInteger(), asFloat()), and initialize() checks each parameter’s type and range (D43), so a run started with slim -d takes either spelling. A new parameter must be converted at each such use (a constant given with -d cannot be redefined in initialize()). R writes every float with a decimal point.

Iterating NULL. A for loop over a zero-length vector runs no iteration, and the model relies on that, but a loop over NULL is an error: guard anything that can be NULL.

Chromosome-aware joins. When splitting IBD segments by chromosome, split each segment on its own — a whole-group comparison against the 14-row chromosome table silently recycles for pairs with more than one segment.

Painting alleles with tskit. To paint the root genomes with tskit itself, simplify with keep_input_roots=True (otherwise the roots are the MRCAs of the genomes kept, and change with them), give each mutation metadata={"mutation_list": []} (SLiM’s schema requires it), and read genotype_matrix(isolated_as_missing=False): by default a genome alone under its root genome, such as an import that infected none of the genomes kept, reads as missing wherever its root is REF.

tskit’s segments are path pieces. Read straight from tskit, a pair’s shared stretches come in pieces that depend on the samples the tree was simplified to, and a stretch can run across a chromosome junction. Merge abutting pieces with the same ancestor and cut at the junctions before counting or drawing them (sections 6.3 and 7 of the model description).
